document.title: Slider shows the base when it is smaller than the head
document.summary: The image slider clips each image to its own side of the line.
document.why: The [image diff slider showed only the new image](source:s1) when the old image was smaller than the new one.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 12
sources.gist: Slider shows only the new image for a smaller old one

groups.title: Clip both slider layers
groups.summary: `WipeStage` now clips the head to the right of the line and the base to the left, each with `clip-path`.

attention.note: Left of the line, the reader now sees only the base. `StageImage` fits each image with `object-fit: contain`, so a base with a different shape leaves empty room; that room and any transparent base pixels now show the checker bench, not the head. Side by side already shows the base this way.

notes.body: The head used to fill the whole frame under the base.
